scope: Code Factory daemon GitHub API reads, read-only GitHub notification intake, cached admin accounting and installed Work settings. Independent clients are outside the application cap.

controlled: REST provider reads and every pagination/redirect hop
Read-only review notifications and targeted request refresh
Selected-item detail and bounded tracked/explicit-reference metadata
removedUnbudgetedLookups: Diagnostics use local gh auth token instead of gh auth status
Managed clone uses Git transport with gh auth git-credential instead of gh repo clone
Agent message delivery records references without synchronously scanning all links
separate: Arbitrary plugins, agent commands, skills and other clients use GitHub independently. The reserve responds to GitHub-reported remaining quota, not a claim to control those clients.

Optional explicit installation of the disabled alternate tunnel client performs one unauthenticated release-metadata lookup when absent. It is not a background poll or part of the daemon authenticated quota; this pilot continues to use Tailscale.

correctness: Reserve attempts durably before sending; restart cannot restore uncertain consumption. Conditional HTTP requests count conservatively against the local cap, cached reads do not.

Observe response quota headers before reading bodies. Honor primary reset, secondary Retry-After/exponential backoff, HTTP-200 GraphQL rate errors and endpoint X-Poll-Interval even when a cursor changes.
Persist credential-scoped ETag/Last-Modified bodies/pagination and bounded GraphQL snapshots. Exclude raw tokens, authorization headers and cookies from cache/accounting output.

Notification GET uses all=true, preserves read/unread state, follows pages and filters configured active repositories before target fetches. Persist cursor and per-thread timestamps; failed batches retain progress.
Routine index imports do not fan out into per-item reviews/comments/commits/checks. Selected/tracked/explicit references refresh within the same gate and inaccessible references back off.
Preserve legacy content revisions when only operational freshness changes. Stale cached PR facts cannot borrow a newer repository checkpoint or replace newer saved facts.
Budget-only settings preserve priority-assessment policy identity; older settings clients preserve omitted fields. Deferred selected details remain unread until successful retry.

representativeAssertions: TestIndexCallCountDoesNotGrowWithPRHistory: 100 requested PRs, two listing calls, no history fan-out
